notes.subject: זרזיר
notes.rationale: זרזיר i stap long Tanakh long dispela ples tasol — mining i no klia: 'wanpela i beltim strongpela long bel'.

notes.subject: זרזיר
notes.rationale: Ol tanim tok i no wankain: 'greyhound' (KJV), 'kakaruk' (Wycliffe, BSB), 'hos' — Hebret i tok tasol 'i girdap long bel'.

notes.subject: אלקום
notes.rationale: אלקום i stap long Tanakh long dispela ples tasol — 'ol i no inap kirap' (lo- = no, קום = kirap).

translation: Samting i beltim strongpela long bel, o bok, na king — i no gat man i ken sanap wantaim em.

tokens.gloss: i no gat man i ken sanap
